4ct3ion Action RunThe subject is "a woman riding a bicycle." The environment is "a quiet urban street bordered by a beige wall and a tree in the background." The outfit is "a casual white T-shirt, beige shorts, and white sneakers." The pose and preparation phase is "sitting upright on the bicycle, holding onto the handlebars." The pose and perspective is "a forward-facing posture with a direct gaze along the path ahead as viewed from a slightly low angle." The explosion phase is "gently beginning to pedal the bicycle." The explosive action is "the legs initiating slight movement, pushing the pedals forward." The direction and camera relationship is "biking in the camera's diagonal direction, moving slightly away from a side-angle view." The dynamic effect is "subtle motion in the leg and pedal movement." The dynamic effect and atmosphere are "calm yet focused, evoking a leisurely cycling ambiance." The perspective and camera effect is "a level-ground perspective capturing the subject and surrounding environment clearly."
Shoot around this character with a smoothly rotating lens to show a 360-degree view of the character and provide an all-round perspective.

严格按照我的撰写公式来描述图像内容，公式是：[主体描述] + [动作状态] + [核心特效] + [视觉效果] + [环境/氛围]。例如：主体描述“一名球员高高跃起”，动作状态“准备将球灌进篮筐里，在半空中被定格，他手中的篮球也停留在飞行的半途中。”，核心特效“这一场景运用了 “子弹时间” 拍摄特效，动作被极大程度地放慢。”，动作状态“这名球员充满动感的姿势和手中的篮球都被凝固住。”，环境/氛围“周围的场景因为这一特效而略显模糊。其中，核心特效“这一场景运用了 “子弹时间” 拍摄特效，动作被极大程度地放慢。”这条提示词保持不变，全部用英文输出。
